title.en: US and Iran exchange strikes and accuse each other of violating ceasefire
title.zh: 美国和伊朗交锋并指责对方违反停火协议

summary.en: Iran says it has launched retaliatory attacks at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after the US said it hit multiple targets across Iran.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The US has conducted new strikes on Iran, following a drone attack on a Panama-flagged vessel in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday.

US Central Command (Centcom) said it hit multiple targets across Iran in direct response to "continued aggression" against commercial shipping.

In retaliation, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said it has launched missiles and drones at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain, in a statement shared to state media.

Following the exchange of fire, the US and Iran accused each other of violating the ceasefire agreement.

Centcom said in a statement, "Iran was given a chance to honor the ceasefire agreement but elected not to when its forces launched a one-way attack drone that hit MT Kiku," a Panama-flagged tanker.

In response, it said, US fighter jets conducted strikes on 10 Iranian military targets at multiple locations in and near the Strait of Hormuz. These included military equipment, communication systems, air defense sites and drone storage facilities.

In the IRGC's statement, it said the US had attacked five coastal posts in Iran under what it called "the pretext of the IRGC Navy confronting the offending ship".

In retaliation, the IRGC said it had launched ballistic missiles and drones at "eight key pieces of infrastructure" at the Ali al-Salem base in Kuwait and the Fifth Naval Fleet in Port Salman, Bahrain, "destroying them".

A US official has told Reuters that there were no reported US casualties or major impacts or damage to US facilities in the Middle East.

The IRGC said that under the Memorandum of Understanding signed earlier this month, Iran has arrangements for controlling passage and navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, and from now on, violating ships will be dealt with more forcefully than in the past.

"Any potential enemy aggression, under any pretext, even if the aggressions are against minor targets, as happened last night and tonight, will have a crushing response," read the statement.

It also accused the US of violating the ceasefire agreed to in the memorandum of understanding between the two nations, warning that it "will lead to a complete halt to the process".

The Iranian Foreign Ministry has also condemned what it described as the "brutal attacks" a violation of the ceasefire, adding it showed that the US "does not place the slightest value and credibility on its commitments, and breaking promises is part of its nature."

Shortly after the latest US strikes on Iran were announced, Trump said on Truth Social that it was "very possible" that Tehran would "never learn".

"There may come a point when we are no longer able to be reasonable, and will be forced to militarily complete the job that we very successfully started," he wrote on Saturday evening.

title.en: 'Islamic Republic of Iran will no longer exist': Trump escalates war of words as truce tested
title.zh: 特朗普言辞升级，称“伊朗伊斯兰共和国将不复存在”，休战协议受考验

summary.en: Iran has fired missiles and drones at US military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain, leading to an escalation in rhetoric from former President Trump, who stated the "Islamic Republic of Iran will no longer exist," further testing a fragile truce.
summary.zh: 伊朗向科威特和巴林境内的美国军事基地发射了导弹和无人机，导致前总统特朗普的言辞升级，他声称“伊朗伊斯兰共和国将不复存在”，这进一步考验了脆弱的休战协议。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump said Iran would "no longer exist" if the US is "forced" to resume the war, as he accused the country of violating a ceasefire on Sunday.

The threat came after US forces said they struck "multiple" Iranian targets in another tit-for-tat response to attacks on shipping in the vital Strait of Hormuz.

"United States aircraft just struck Iranian missile and drone storage locations, and coastal radar sites, for violating the Cease Fire Agreement, AGAIN!" Trump wrote on Truth Social.

"There may come a point when we are no longer able to be reasonable, and will be forced to militarily complete the job that we very successfully started," he continued.

The clashes brought new tension to the negotiating process meant to end a war launched by the US and Israel at the end of February.

They also underlined the risks still facing one of the world's most important sea lanes for oil and other commodities.

US Central Command said it had struck 10 Iranian military targets in response to an Iranian drone attack on the Panama-flagged oil tanker Kiku, which was carrying some two million barrels of crude.

The US military said the response targeted "surveillance infrastructure, communication systems, air defense sites, drone storage facilities, and minelayer capabilities".

Iranian media reported several explosions in the Sirik and Qeshm areas of southern Iran.

In retaliation, Iran has launched multiple missiles and drones toward neighbouring countries, including Bahrain and Kuwait, a US official confirmed to the Reuters news agency.

The official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said there were no reported US casualties or major impacts or damage to US facilities in the Middle East at this time.

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has said in a statement that US violations of the ceasefire are "contrary" to the recently signed "memorandum of understanding" and "will result in the complete halt of all diplomatic processes".

The group also said they were taking measures to control traffic in the vital Strait of Hormuz and that violating vessels would be dealt with more firmly than before. The only passage authorised by Tehran passes through a corridor running along Iran's coast.

The IRGC said Iran's retaliatory strikes had "destroyed eight important US military facilities at the Ali al-Salem base in Kuwait and at the Fifth Fleet naval base in Port Salman in Bahrain".

title.en: 6.7 million people affected by Venezuela earthquakes, UN says, locals plead for more aid
title.zh: 联合国称委内瑞拉地震影响670万人，当地居民恳求更多援助

body.en:
Close to seven million people may have been impacted by the twin earthquakes that struck Venezuela on Thursday, leaving nearly 1,500 dead.

The United Nations migration agency estimated on Sunday that "up to 6.76 million people could be affected by the devastating earthquakes".

The International Organization for Migration (IOM) projection highlights the "potentially vast humanitarian impact" of the disaster as locals on the ground claim the government is not responding quickly enough.

Venezuela's interim leader Delcy Rodriguez was booed during a visit to a neighbourhood in the capital Caracas that had been badly affected by the natural disaster.

"The government isn't doing anything for the people," residents yelled on Saturday, many of whom had loved ones trapped under the debris.

Three days after two powerful tremors of magnitude 7.2 and 7.5 hit , 50,000 people are still missing. The death toll has risen to 1,430 people — according to National Assembly president Jorge Rodríguez — and fury with perceived governmental inaction is mounting.

As the first US aid flight landed in Caracas, millions of Venezuelans are feared to lack sanitation and other basic needs.

Rodriguez has thanked the international community for the significant outpouring of aid.

However, local residents are being forced to desperately claw away rubble from collapsed apartment buildings.

Experts say the first 72 hours after natural disasters are the key, narrow window for finding the living.

"It's just very chaotic, hot and unorganised," Australian firefighter Craig De Meillon, 43, told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency. He travelled alone to La Guaira from Miami to help.

UN aid chief Tom Fletcher on Friday told AFP the death toll could continue to soar.

One runway at Simon Bolivar International Airport is partially functioning for aid landings. A US naval ship has also arrived off the coast.

There was joy in the hardest-hit coastal area of La Guaira, north of Caracas, when locals pulled an infant alive out of the wreckage on Saturday, 32 hours after the initial shocks.

In one social media video, a man welled up in tears as he held the baby in his arms.

Already battered by years of a failing economy and the turbulence of the US intervention to abduct leader Nicolas Maduro in January , Venezuelans are increasingly expressing their anger with the government.

Yessica Mendoza was forced to transport her own daughter to a morgue in Caracas after 25-year-old Yesimar Rodriguez and her husband Jhomel Anaya, 26, did not survive the tumbling debris of their home in La Guaira on Wednesday.

title.en: Bad Bunny: Latin star lights up London with history-making stadium show
title.zh: 坏兔子：拉丁明星以创造历史的体育场表演点亮伦敦

summary.en: Pride and a party as the Puerto Rican becomes the first Latin artist to headline a UK stadium.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Bad Bunny brought Latin America to London on Saturday night, as he became the first artist from that part of the world to headline a UK stadium.

The Puerto Rican rapper captivated a star-studded crowd of about 50,000 on the first of two sold-out nights in Tottenham, with a celebration of Central and South American culture, communities - and even the climate.

The fans' energy levels defied the hot and humid conditions with a fiesta from start to finish.

But as the singer sent a message of solidarity to Venezuela following its devastating earthquakes, it was also an evening of contrasting emotions.

Bad Bunny - whose real name is Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio - is approaching the end of his Debí Tirar Más Fotos world tour.

And the 32-year-old performed with the low-key confidence and charisma of an artist now completely comfortable on the world's biggest stages.

The setlist was unsurprisingly dominated by the album that gives the tour its name.

DTMF, as it's also known, made history at the Grammy Awards in February as the first sung entirely in Spanish to win album of the year.

Starting the show where the record ends, La Mudanza (The Move) set the tone for the evening - showcasing his ability to blur genre boundaries, blending modern Latin rap with old-school salsa, supported by a live traditional band.

But several songs later, it was Nuevayol that really got the party started, as one of the standout singles to help Bad Bunny break through into more mainstream British audiences.

You don't need to understand the lyrics - or to have grown up with the more native sounds - to be swept up in his universally danceable rhythms, cinematic samples and infectious hooks.

But for those who are invested in the words, DTMF is also a deeply personal record - exploring loss and longing, against a backdrop of nostalgia and identity.

The themes have been brought to visual life on this tour through stunning stadium-scale production, with a Puerto Rican-style home at the back of the stadium floor serving as a second stage.

Known as La Casita, it gives the show a communal and intimate feel, putting him among the crowd - as though performing at the world's biggest house party in the local town the design evokes.

Despite the size (and, no doubt, cost) of the spectacle, it has a humble character - favouring homely and traditional imagery, over the high-tech mega-runways of other contemporary stadium shows.

And the three-hour performance was a reminder that his global success didn't happen overnight, with him digging deep into his eight-year discography - traversing trap and reggaeton fusions.

Naturally, this created relative lulls in the set for those newer to the singer and a welcome chance to catch a breath.

body.zh: 周六晚上，Bad Bunny 将拉丁美洲带到了伦敦，成为世界上第一位在英国体育场担任主角的来自该地区的艺术家。 这位波多黎各说唱歌手在托特纳姆热刺的两晚门票全部售完的第一晚，吸引了大约 50,000 名明星云集的观众，庆祝了中美洲和南美洲的文化、社区甚至气候。 球迷们的能量水平从始至终都在对抗炎热和潮湿的环境，充满了节日气氛。 但当这位歌手在遭受毁灭性地震后向委内瑞拉发出声援信息时，这也是一个充满对比情绪的夜晚。 Bad Bunny（坏兔子）的真名是 Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio（贝尼托·安东尼奥·马丁内斯·奥卡西奥），他的 Debí Tirar Más Fotos 世界巡演即将结束。 这位 32 岁的艺术家的表演充满了低调的自信和魅力，就像一位现在在世界最大的舞台上完全自在的艺术家。 毫不奇怪，专辑中以巡演命名的专辑为主。 DTMF（也称为 DTMF）在二月份的格莱美奖上创造了历史，成为第一张完全用西班牙语演唱的年度专辑。 在唱片结束的地方开始演出，La Mudanza (The Move) 为当晚定下了基调 - 展示了他模糊流派界限的能力，在现场传统乐队的支持下，将现代拉丁说唱与老式萨尔萨舞融为一体。 但几首歌之后，真正让派对开始的是《Nuevayol》，它是帮助《Bad Bunny》打入更多英国主流听众的杰出单曲之一。 你不需要理解歌词，也不需要在更本土的声音中长大，就能被他普遍适合跳舞的节奏、电影样本和富有感染力的旋律所吸引。 但对于那些热衷于文字的人来说，DTMF 也是一份深刻的个人记录——在怀旧和身份的背景下探索失落和渴望。 通过令人惊叹的体育场规模制作，这些主题在这次巡演中被带入了视觉生活，体育场地板后面的波多黎各风格的住宅作为第二舞台。 它被称为“La Casita”，给这场表演带来了一种公共和亲密的感觉，让他置身于人群之中——就像在设计所唤起的当地小镇上世界上最大的家庭聚会上表演一样。 尽管这场盛会的规模很大（毫无疑问，成本也很高），但它有一个谦虚的性格——与其他当代体育场表演的高科技巨型跑道相比，它更喜欢朴素和传统的形象。 三个小时的表演提醒人们，他的全球成功并非一朝一夕之事，他深入挖掘了八年的唱片记录——穿越 trap 和雷鬼融合。 自然地，这为那些刚接触这位歌手的人带来了相对平静的气氛，也是一个喘口气的好机会。 当晚唯一虎头蛇尾的时刻到来了……

title.en: These women said no to having kids - here's why
title.zh: 这些女性拒绝生孩子——原因如下

summary.en: From financial constraints to worries about the environment, women tell the BBC why they do not want kids.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Jess King always assumed she would have children. To her, it felt like a natural path all women eventually followed.

But as she got older, she couldn't shake a persistent feeling that she wasn't ready. With time, her doubts deepened.

Everyone she spoke to with children said they'd been really sure about it and they had a maternal urge.

Like Jess, more and more women in the UK are choosing not to have children. Research by the Centre for Social Justice (CSJ) suggests around three million women aged 16 to 45 are likely to stay childfree.

If women in this age bracket were still having children at the same rate as their grandparents, 600,000 more of them would be having children.

According to data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS), births in England and Wales fell for the fourth year in a row in 2025, to their lowest level in nearly half a century.

The CSJ's report cites "a range of social and economic pressures" as the reasons behind their figures. It found that rising housing costs, delayed financial independence, later marriage and growing uncertainty about careers all played a role.

Financial pressures are also a consideration for Jess, who lives in west London with her partner, Ollie.

Jess, a content creator, is self-employed, meaning her income is "up and down", which would be a worry for her if she chose to have children.

"There are so many people struggling to get by. Some months, we are really scraping the pennies and it can be difficult."

Several women I spoke to identified financial constraints as a limiting factor. But they also pointed to a broader set of considerations: anxieties about climate change, a strong commitment to their careers, an eagerness to travel, and a sense that today's world offers them greater freedom of choice.

Both Jess and Chy, 33, say they found support in online communities of people who had built happy lives without children.

The hashtag #childfree features over 127,900 videos on TikTok, while #childfreebychoice has more than 68,100. Scrolling through them, I can see there are thousands of women discussing their reasons for not wanting to become mothers.

Jess says social media didn't influence her decision not to have children, but it "validated it" and made her feel more comfortable to share her thoughts on the subject.

Chy, a 33-year-old account manager from the Midlands, has also found a community of like-minded women online. In real life, while her parents and close friends have been supportive of her being childfree, her wider family could not understand her decision.

"I come from an African background," she says, explaining that many of her relatives are from a culture where "women are supposed to have kids".

"Being someone with resistance to that idea was met with a lot of shock...
body.zh: 杰西·金一直以为她会有孩子。对她来说，这感觉就像是所有女性最终都会遵循的一条自然道路。 但随着年龄的增长，她始终无法摆脱一种自己还没有准备好的感觉。随着时间的推移，她的疑虑越来越深。 她采访过的每个有孩子的人都表示，他们对此非常确定，并且有一种母性的冲动。 像杰西一样，越来越多的英国女性选择不生孩子。社会正义中心 (CSJ) 的研究表明，大约 300 万 16 至 45 岁的女性可能不会生育。 如果这个年龄段的女性生育孩子的比例仍与祖父母相同，那么她们中的生育人数将增加 60 万人。 英国国家统计局(ONS)的数据显示，2025年英格兰和威尔士的出生率连续第四年下降，降至近半个世纪以来的最低水平。 CSJ 的报告将“一系列社会和经济压力”作为其数据背后的原因。研究发现，住房成本上涨、经济独立延迟、晚婚以及职业生涯不确定性增加都起到了一定作用。 杰西和她的伴侣奥利住在伦敦西部，经济压力也是她要考虑的一个因素。 杰西是一位内容创作者，她是一名个体经营者，这意味着她的收入“上下波动”，如果她选择生孩子，这将是她的一个担忧。 “有很多人在艰难度日。有几个月，我们真的是在省吃俭用，这可能很困难。” 我采访过的几位女性都认为经济困难是一个限制因素。但他们也指出了更广泛的考虑因素：对气候变化的焦虑、对职业的坚定承诺、对旅行的渴望，以及对当今世界为他们提供更大选择自由的感觉。 33 岁的 Jess 和 Chy 都表示，他们在网络社区中找到了支持，这些社区中的人们在没有孩子的情况下也过上了幸福的生活。 话题标签 #childfree 在 TikTok 上拥有超过 127,900 个视频，而 #childfreebychoice 则拥有超过 68,100 个视频。浏览它们，我可以看到有成千上万的女性在讨论她们不想成为母亲的原因。 杰西说，社交媒体并没有影响她不生孩子的决定，但它“证实了这一点”，让她更愿意分享自己对这个问题的想法。 来自中部地区的 33 岁客户经理 Chy 也在网上找到了一个由志同道合的女性组成的社区。在现实生活中，虽然她的父母和亲密朋友一直支持她不要孩子，但她的家人却无法理解她的决定。 “我来自非洲背景，”她说，并解释说她的许多亲戚都来自“女人应该生孩子”的文化。 “作为一个抵制这个想法的人，我感到非常震惊......

title.en: Sort Your Life Out: The four most common cluttering mistakes and how to fix them
title.zh: 整理你的生活：四种最常见的杂乱错误及如何解决

summary.en: Tidying expert Dilly Carter has provided her top recommendations for organizing various areas of the home, including kitchens, living rooms, and wardrobes, to help individuals manage common cluttering issues.
summary.zh: 整理专家迪莉·卡特分享了她关于整理厨房、客厅和衣物的最佳技巧，以帮助人们解决常见的杂乱问题。

body.en:
The tidying expert from BBC One's Sort Your Life Out once helped an ex-boyfriend clear up and organise his mother's home after she died.

"It was a way that I could help him," Carter says. "And in doing that, we ended up getting back together." They're married now.

Growing up in a chaotic home with two working parents, she learned early on that she preferred being tidy and organised.

Carter worked as a PA for business executives and, as well as keeping their diaries in order, began making sure their homes were too.

Tidying expert Dilly Carter chats to celebrity guests about their favourite objects at home and why they are so important to them.

In her new BBC video podcast, Sort Your Life Out Unpacked , she interviews famous faces, including Sophie Ellis-Bextor and Lorraine Kelly, about their favourites items and advises how they can best keep their homes free of clutter.

I asked Carter what she thinks are the four most common cluttering mistakes - and how you can fix them.

Bread maker? Air fryer? Blender? Juicer? Mandoline slicer with cut-resistant gloves and hand guard?

The array of kitchen appliances promising to optimise your cooking experience and save you time is endless.

But they need to go somewhere and often that's your kitchen counter top, which - thanks to such clutter- feels increasingly cramped.

"I like to think of kitchens as real estate," says Carter. "Everything in your kitchen has to earn its place in there."

She commonly sees kitchens where infrequently used gadgets take up "prime real estate"; things which could be stored in drawers, cupboards or even the loft, if it's something really gathering dust.

"Go through your kitchen regularly and check what you need, see what you use regularly and [what] you don't."

Another tip is not to buy so many kitchen appliances to begin with but, if you do, make sure it's a "multi-use product".

For example, blenders are more versatile than juicers. If you want to make juice instead of a smoothie, you can extract liquid from the blended pulp of fruits and vegetables using a sieve or cheesecloth - no need for a specific gadget only does one thing.

Rolling your T-shirts may be an efficient way of getting them into a drawer but you won't be able to see them all when you're picking your outfit for the day.

File folding (where the pile is on its side instead of clothes being stacked on top of each other) ensures you can at least see the colour of the T-shirt even if you can't see the image or design on the front.

"We only roll or fold when we're trying to maximise the space of a drawer," says Carter, though you should be careful about which clothes you choose to file fold.

She recommends looking at the age and material of your shirts, blouses and T-shirts before deciding how to store...
body.zh: BBC One 节目《整理你的生活》(Sort Your Life Out) 节目中的整理专家曾经帮助一位前男友在母亲去世后清理并整理她的家。 “这是我可以帮助他的一种方式，”卡特说。 “通过这样做，我们最终又复合了。”他们现在结婚了。 她在一个混乱的家庭中长大，有两个工作父母，她很早就知道自己更喜欢整洁和有条理。 卡特担任企业高管的私人助理，除了让他们的日记井井有条外，还开始确保他们的家也井然有序。 整理专家迪莉·卡特与名人嘉宾谈论他们最喜欢的家里物品以及为什么这些物品对他们如此重要。 在她的新 BBC 视频播客《整理你的生活，解开包装》中，她采访了索菲·埃利斯-贝斯特和洛林·凯利等名人，了解他们最喜欢的物品，并建议他们如何最好地保持家中整洁。 我问卡特，她认为四种最常见的混乱错误是什么，以及如何解决它们。 面包机？空气炸锅？混合器？榨汁机？带防割手套和护手的曼陀林切片机？ 承诺优化您的烹饪体验并节省您时间的厨房电器种类繁多。 但他们需要去某个地方，而通常那是你的厨房台面，由于如此混乱，它感觉越来越局促。 “我喜欢将厨房视为房地产，”卡特说。 “厨房里的所有东西都必须在那里找到自己的位置。” 她经常看到厨房里不常用的小玩意占据了“黄金地段”；可以存放在抽屉、橱柜甚至阁楼中的东西，如果它确实积满灰尘的话。 “定期检查你的厨房，检查你需要什么，看看你经常使用什么，不使用什么。” 另一个建议是不要一开始就购买这么多厨房用具，但如果你这样做，请确保它是“多用途产品”。 例如，搅拌机比榨汁机更通用。如果您想制作果汁而不是冰沙，您可以使用筛子或粗棉布从水果和蔬菜的混合果肉中提取液体 - 不需要特定的小工具，只需做一件事。 将 T 恤卷起来可能是将它们放入抽屉的有效方法，但当您挑选当天的服装时，您将无法看到所有它们。 文件折叠（将衣服堆放在一边，而不是衣服叠在一起）可确保您至少可以看到 T 恤的颜色，即使您看不到正面的图像或设计。 卡特说：“只有当我们试图最大化抽屉空间时，我们才会卷起或折叠起来。”尽管您应该小心选择折叠哪些衣服。 她建议在决定如何存放之前先查看衬衫、衬衫和 T 恤的年代和材质……

reflection.en: Even seemingly small tasks like organizing our homes can be approached with intentionality and diligence. When we commit our daily efforts to Yahweh, we find purpose in creating orderly and peaceful spaces that reflect good stewardship. This perspective transforms mundane chores into meaningful acts of care for our surroundings.
reflection.zh: 即使是整理家居这样看似微小的任务，我们也可以带着目标和勤勉去完成。当我们把日常的努力献给雅伟时，我们会在创造整洁宁静的空间中找到意义，这反映了良好的管家职分。这种视角将平凡的家务转化为有意义的对我们周遭环境的照料。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: I'm in therapy for my 14-hour-a-day phone addiction and I'm determined to beat it
title.zh: 我每天 14 小时沉迷于手机，正在接受治疗，并且决心战胜它

summary.en: Addiction treatment centres say more clients are coming for help with "out-of-control" phone use.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Marios's phone pings and lights up. He's just received a WhatsApp message from me asking for an initial chat about this story.

He wants to answer straightaway. The urge, he later tells me, feels overpowering.

However, he's currently in the middle of a therapy session about his phone addiction. He can't answer it now.

He holds his nerve. But as soon as the meeting finishes, he's back on his phone and an hour later, we meet on a video call.

"I'm so sorry," I say. "The last thing I wanted to do was disturb your session."

"Don't worry," Marios sighs. "This is the feeling I've had for many years: this uncontrollable need to be on my phone.

"My drug is always in my pocket, flashing, beeping me and reminding me to take a dose."

On a bad day, Marios, a personal trainer, can spend more than 14 hours staring at his screen (Instagram, he says, is the killer for him). But now, he is trying a 12-session course of private therapy to try to curb this compulsion, which he believes is driven by loneliness.

One look at my screen time statistics tells me I checked my phone 116 times yesterday. I also spent over three hours gawping at it.

Phone addiction does not yet exist as an official condition, but in a recent survey of 1,000 adults by Deloitte, , external 70% of respondents said they spent too much time on their phones. As a growing number of academics warn that smartphones are changing our brain chemistry, experts in addiction have told me they are seeing more clients completely dependent on their devices.

Last year, one in three clients treated for drug dependency by UK Addiction Treatment Centres (UKAT), which supports 3,500 people a year, also had a secondary phone dependency. That's up from just one in 10 in 2019.

Some clients even back out of treatment for their primary addiction because they refuse to surrender their device when they enter the clinic, says UKAT.

But when does someone tip over from being an overkeen texter to needing professional help?

As I drive up the tree-lined driveway to Rainford Hall, I'm greeted by huge stained-glass windows dating back to Jacobean times, overlooking manicured gardens.

This Steps Together rehab centre in St Helens, Merseyside, also hosts people struggling with other addictions (including drugs, alcohol and gambling) but its therapists are seeing an increasing number of people who cannot switch off from their devices.

"It can affect anyone from any background," lead therapist Kelly Watson explains. "We all have phones, we all have similar brain circuitry, and so many of us can become addicted."

title.en: Ukraine strikes Russian weapons plant, Moscow fuel hub
title.zh: 乌克兰袭击俄罗斯武器工厂和莫斯科燃料枢纽

summary.en: Ukraine has launched drone attacks on a Russian weapons plant and a fuel hub in the Volgograd and Vladimir regions. These strikes are part of President Zelenskyy's stated strategy to extend the conflict to Russian territory and compel President Putin to engage in peace negotiations.
summary.zh: 乌克兰对俄罗斯伏尔加格勒和弗拉基米尔地区的武器工厂和燃料枢纽发动了无人机袭击。泽连斯基总统表示，这些袭击是其战略的一部分，旨在将战火引向俄罗斯人民，迫使普京进行和平谈判。

body.en:
The two attacks, in Volgograd and Vladimir regions, are part of President Zelenskyy's strategy to bring the war to the Russian people and force Putin into peace negotiations.

Ukraine continued attacks deep in Russian territory on Saturday, striking premises in the city of Volgograd that produce advanced weapons, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

In a second major strike, Kyiv said Ukrainian drones hit an oil pumping station that delivers fuel to Russia's  capital, Moscow . 

The two attacks came a day after Ukraine launched one of its biggest drone assaults in the four-and-a-half-year-old war , targeting a dozen Russian regions, Crimea and shipping at sea.

Zelenskyy wrote on X that Ukrainian-made FP-5 Flamingo missiles hit the Titan-Barrikady facility in Volgograd in southwestern Russia, which he described as a “major industrial complex.”

He said Russia produces "artillery systems and specialized military equipment, including components for missile launch systems" at the site.

Ukraine's General Staff said the facility makes equipment for missile systems, including self-propelled launchers and transport-loading vehicles for the Iskander-M missile system.

Russia confirmed the attack, with regional Governor Andrei Bocharov writing on Telegram that at least 10 people were wounded and taken to the hospital.

Around the same time Saturday, Ukrainian drones attacked a Russian oil pumping station crucial for Moscow's fuel supply, Ukraine's SBU Security Service said.

The strikes hit a technical building at the facility owned by the state-owned oil pipeline giant, Transneft.

The facility is based in Vtorovo, near the capital of the Vladimir region, east of Moscow.

The Kremlin has yet to comment on the strike, the second successful attack on the pumping station in a month.

Russia, meanwhile, launched strikes on at least three regions of Ukraine overnight, killing two people and wounding more than 20, according to Ukrainian authorities.

In the central eastern Dnipropetrovsk region, one person was killed and two were injured when drones and aerial bombs struck two districts more than 30 times, an official wrote on Telegram .

A 66-year-old man was killed in a Russian drone attack on a house in the northern Sumy region, according to the regional military governor.

The governor spoke of "a massive attack" elsewhere in the same region bordering Russia that injured 10 people.

Strikes on the southeastern town of Zaporizhzhia injured nine, including two children, Ukraine's State Emergency Service said.

title.en: Why is the US targeting Germany's drug industry?
title.zh: 美国为何针对德国制药业？

summary.en: A new trade probe is reigniting a long-running clash over who should pay for medical innovation. Washington argues Germans benefit from lower prices while US patients shoulder a disproportionate share of the costs.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A new trade probe is reigniting a long-running clash over who should pay for medical innovation. Washington argues Germans benefit from lower prices while US patients shoulder a disproportionate share of the costs.

In the world according to Donald Trump , every nation on the face of the earth is "ripping off" the United States — that goes for pharmaceuticals, too, especially those from Germany.

Now, the Trump administration is targeting Germany with an investigation. Washington says it wants to find out if US patients and businesses are being forced to pay disproportionately higher prices for the research and development of top-tier pharmaceuticals so that German patients can pay less. The inquiry, scheduled to wrap up in September, is based on Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 and could ultimately lead to new US tariffs.

The conflict touches on a core aspect of health policy. Germany regulates drug prices through its public health insurance system in order to keep access affordable. The US sees this as market distortion. Berlin defends its price regulating practice as a legitimate instrument for keeping costs down. The issue of drug pricing has now evolved into a trade policy dispute that goes far beyond the pharmaceutical sector. 

At its core, the question now is whether US pharmaceutical companies are put at a disadvantage as a result of Germany's price regulation system, which Washington says creates a trade imbalance. According to the OECD, an organization of wealthy industrialized nations, the US and Germany are the two countries that spend the most on drugs. In 2023, US patients spent an average of $1,713 (€1,502) per person on medicine compared to $1,158 per patient in Germany.

"This investigation will seek to determine whether persistent underpayment for innovative pharmaceutical products by Germany is unreasonable or discriminatory and burdens or restricts US commerce," according to US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, who added that the "investigation follows months of meaningful discussions with our German partners in an effort to resolve this issue."

"President Trump has made clear that American patients should not be shouldering a disproportionate share of global pharmaceutical research and development," continued Greer. "I am particularly concerned with news that Germany is fast-tracking legislation that would further reduce its spending on innovative pharmaceuticals."

With that, the US is directly targeting German Health Minister Nina Warken's multi-billion-euro healthcare savings package slated to be passed by the Bundestag within the next few weeks and aimed at forcing further rebates from pharmaceutical companies.

title.en: Military-age Ukrainian men could lose EU protection
title.zh: 军事年龄乌克兰男性或将失去欧盟保护

summary.en: The European Commission has suggested withdrawing protection status for military-age Ukrainian males. A number of EU countries support the move — and so does Kyiv.
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会提议取消对军事年龄乌克兰男性的临时保护身份，此举得到了多个欧盟国家和乌克兰本国的支持。

body.en:
The European Commission has suggested withdrawing protection status for military-age Ukrainian males. A number of EU countries support the move — and so does Kyiv.

"Our proposal provides that temporary protection should not be granted to newly arriving persons who are not allowed to leave Ukraine because of their military obligations," said Magnus Brunner, the European commissioner for internal affairs and migration, while announcing proposed changes to European protective status for Ukrainians on Friday.

Protection status for Ukrainians as such should remain in place, said Brunner at a meeting of EU interior ministers in Luxembourg in early June, though new conditions could apply.

Ukrainians forced to flee their country as a result of Russia's invasion of their homeland have enjoyed temporary protection status in the EU since March 2022.

That status is set to end in early March 2027, and must now be extended before it expires. The difference between this status and asylum is that the protection is temporary and those entering the bloc are not subject to individual case-by-case review.

The proposal by the European Commission is formulated in gender-neutral terms, emphasized one EU official. But ultimately, it will most likely affect men between the ages of 23 and 60. The update worked out in the new proposal — which does not apply to Ukrainians already in the EU — would only come into effect when the Council of Europe officially approves and publishes it in the Official Journal of the European Union, underscored another Commission official.

On March 31, the EU's statistics agency Eurostat counted a total of 4.33 million Ukrainians living in the bloc under temporary protection status. Of these, nearly 1.3 million (29.4% of the EU total) were in Germany , followed by 950,000 in Poland (22.2% of the total) and 380,000 in the Czech Republic (8.8%). Slightly more than one-quarter of those in the bloc were adult males, said the agency.

Michael O'Flaherty, commissioner for human rights at the Council of Europe — which is not an EU institution — criticized the proposal. O'Flaherty expressed concern over "mounting pressure to prematurely end temporary protection arrangements" and to limit access for military-age males, among others. The commissioner said that now is the time for "more solidarity, not less." 

The EU has justified the new proposal by saying Ukraine had requested the move, and that Kyiv's need to impress military obligations upon its own citizens to defend itself were legitimate. Brunner said Friday that the proposal had been put forth in coordination with EU member states.

body.zh: 欧盟委员会建议取消对乌克兰军龄男性的保护地位。许多欧盟国家支持这一举措，基辅也是如此。 欧盟内部事务和移民事务专员马格努斯·布伦纳 (Magnus Brunner) 表示：“我们的提案规定，不应向因军事义务而不得离开乌克兰的新抵达者提供临时保护。”同时，周五宣布了对乌克兰人欧洲保护地位的拟议修改。 布伦纳在六月初于卢森堡举行的欧盟内政部长会议上表示，乌克兰人的保护地位应保持不变，但可能会适用新的条件。 自 2022 年 3 月以来，因俄罗斯入侵家园而被迫逃离祖国的乌克兰人在欧盟享有临时保护地位。 该状态将于 2027 年 3 月上旬结束，现在必须在到期前延长。这种身份与庇护的区别在于，保护是暂时的，进入欧盟的人不受个人个案审查。 一位欧盟官员强调，欧盟委员会的提案是以性别中立的方式制定的。但最终，它很可能会影响 23 岁至 60 岁之间的男性。另一位欧盟委员会官员强调，新提案中的更新内容（不适用于已经在欧盟的乌克兰人）只有在欧洲委员会正式批准并在欧盟官方公报上发布后才会生效。 3月31日，欧盟统计局统计，在欧盟境内处于临时保护状态的乌克兰人总数为433万。其中，德国有近130万（占欧盟总数的29.4％），其次是波兰95万（占总数的22.2％）和捷克共和国38万（占8.8％）。该机构表示，该地区略多于四分之一的人是成年男性。 欧洲委员会（不是欧盟机构）的人权专员迈克尔·奥弗拉赫蒂批评了这一提议。奥弗莱厄蒂对“过早结束临时保护安排的压力越来越大”以及限制军龄男性的进入等表示担忧。这位专员表示，现在是“加强而不是减少团结”的时候了。 欧盟为新提议的合理性辩护称，乌克兰要求采取这一行动，并且基辅需要向本国公民施加军事义务以保卫自己，这是合法的。布伦纳周五表示，该提案是与欧盟成员国协调提出的。 当欧盟内政部长会议讨论这一问题时，德国内政部长亚历山大·多布林特表示支持……

title.en: Balochistan activist's life sentence raises fear of unrest
title.zh: 俾路支省活动人士被判无期徒刑引发对骚乱的担忧

summary.en: With the conviction of a leading rights campaigner, Pakistan has drawn criticism from rights groups and sparked fears it could deepen unrest in Balochistan and weaken trust in peaceful activism.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
With the conviction of a leading rights campaigner, Pakistan has drawn criticism from rights groups and sparked fears it could deepen unrest in Balochistan and weaken trust in peaceful activism.

A Pakistani  anti-terrorism court this week sentenced two civil rights activists to life imprisonment over the killing of a paramilitary soldier during a July 2024 protest.

Mahrang Baloch, 33, is a prominent campaigner against alleged enforced disappearances in Balochistan and leader of the Balochistan Unity Committee (BYC). On June 25, she was convicted of murder and terrorism alongside fellow activist Sibghatullah Shahji. Both activists boycotted the trial and have denied the charges against them.

Baloch's lawyer, Israr Jattak, said the activists would appeal the verdict. Jattak recently met with the pair and reported that they were in good mental and physical health.

"The court is using the law as a weapon against us. The court and the judicial system exposed themselves through this judgment," Baloch told DW via her lawyer. 

The verdict drew sharp criticism from rights organizations . The Human Rights Commission of Pakistan called for a review of the ruling, saying the state had "continued its policy of treating fundamental rights advocacy in the same way it treats extremism, resulting in administrative and judicial decisions that are one-sided and biased."

Shahid Rind, a spokesperson for the Balochistan government, told DW that the prosecution was conducted fairly, insisting the case was backed by "undeniable evidence" and was not politically motivated.

Baloch and Shahji were arrested in March 2025 and are being held at Hudda District Prison in Balochistan's capital, Quetta.

According to the prosecution, Baloch did not physically kill the paramilitary soldier herself. Instead, prosecutors alleged that she incited and led a crowd during a July 2024 protest in Gwadar, and that the crowd attacked security personnel.

They said a paramilitary soldier, Sepoy Shabbir Ahmed, became separated from his colleagues and was beaten to death by protesters.

"These allegations are being used to create an atmosphere where political dissent is branded as a crime and demands for human rights are labelled as enmity against the state," said Baloch in a statement issued from the jail and posted on BYC's official social media accounts earlier this month.

Mahrang Baloch is a medical doctor-turned-human rights activist and a leading figure in the Baloch Yakjehti Committee (BYC), a human rights movement based in Balochistan. 

Her activism began after her father, Abdul Ghaffar Langove, was allegedly forcibly disappeared in 2009. His body was later recovered in 2011.

title.zh: 澳大利亚队在G组戏剧性收官后将在世界杯淘汰赛中对阵埃及队

summary.en: Australia's World Cup knockout opponent was only decided in the dying moments of the final Group G matches, setting the stage for a dramatic clash with Egypt.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚队的世界杯淘汰赛对手在G组最后一场比赛的最后时刻才确定，这将是一场与埃及队的激烈对决。

body.en:
Australia will face Egypt in the World Cup Round of 32 after the Pharaohs held on to finish second in Group G following a dramatic final round of matches.

Egypt sealed its place in the knockout rounds on Saturday afternoon (AEST) with a 1-1 draw against Iran, but was denied top spot in Group G after Belgium thrashed New Zealand 5-1 to edge the Pharaohs on goal difference.

That means Australia will face Egypt in the Round of 32 at Arlington, Texas, at 4am AEST next Saturday. The two sides have never met at a World Cup before.

It's still unclear whether Egyptian star player Mohamed Salah will play in the match.

Salah — who became one of the English Premier League's most celebrated players after signing with Liverpool in 2017 — came off in the 57th minute in the Egypt-Iran match and was seen having his left leg bandaged.

"The doctor will write his report when we get back to the hotel and will carry out a second examination. I spoke with Salah and, God willing, the injury doesn't seem serious," Hassan said.

The Group G standings changed several times throughout the simultaneous matches, with Belgium, Iran and Egypt all sitting second in the group at various times.

In their match against Egypt , Iran scored a stoppage-time goal, which was ruled offside by VAR. Had the goal stood, Iran would have finished second and played Australia next Saturday.

They now face an agonising wait to see if they qualify as one of the top eight third-placed teams.

After a 1-5 defeat to Belgium, New Zealand finished last in the group with one point and were eliminated from the tournament.

Former Socceroo Harry Kewell, speaking before the results were announced, told SBS that Belgium and Egypt looked to be the most dangerous of Australia's opponents.

"Once you get through the group stages, which they successfully navigated through, it's all about now.

"This is where you have to play your best football. This is where you have to strike when your chances are low, you've got to be able to be clinical, and hopefully we can do that and progress one step further."

The challenge for the Australian side will be to play their best football with a couple of players out of action.

The Socceroos are down to a 24-player squad after the injured Jacob Italiano and Mathew Leckie left camp for Austria and Melbourne, respectively.

Italiano played against Türkiye and the United States but was injured at training, while Leckie hurt his hamstring in the side's 2-0 defeat to the US.

Australia have played Egypt twice before, winning a President's Cup match on penalties in 1987. They lost a friendly in Cairo 3-0 in 2010.

body.zh: 澳大利亚队将在世界杯 32 强赛中对阵埃及队，法老队在最后一轮比赛中戏剧性地保住了 G 组第二名的成绩。 周六下午（澳大利亚东部标准时间），埃及以 1-1 战平伊朗队锁定了淘汰赛席位，但在比利时 5-1 击败新西兰队，以净胜球优势击败法老队后，埃及队未能获得 G 组头名位置。 这意味着澳大利亚将于下周六凌晨 4 点在德克萨斯州阿灵顿举行的 32 强赛中对阵埃及。此前，两队从未在世界杯上交手过。 目前还不清楚埃及明星球员穆罕默德·萨拉赫是否会参加比赛。 萨拉赫在 2017 年与利物浦签约后成为英超最著名的球员之一，他在对阵伊朗的比赛中第 57 分钟下场，人们看到他的左腿缠着绷带。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 在同时进行的比赛中，G组的排名发生了多次变化，比利时、伊朗和埃及在不同时期都位居小组第二。 在对阵埃及的比赛中，伊朗队补时阶段打入一球，但被VAR判定越位。如果进球有效，伊朗队将获得第二名，并在下周六对阵澳大利亚队。 他们现在面临着痛苦的等待，看看自己是否有资格成为前八名第三名的球队之一。 新西兰队1-5负于比利时队后，积1分小组垫底，被淘汰出局。 前足球运动员哈里·科威尔在结果公布前告诉SBS，比利时和埃及看起来是澳大利亚最危险的对手。 “一旦你通过了小组赛阶段，他们也成功地通过了，现在就是一切了。 “这是你必须踢出最好足球的地方。这是当你的机会很低时你必须出击的地方，你必须能够保持冷静，希望我们能够做到这一点并更进一步。” 澳大利亚队面临的挑战是在几名球员缺阵的情况下踢出最好的足球。 在雅各布·意大利（Jacob Italiano）和马修·莱基（Mathew Leckie）受伤分别离开训练营前往奥地利和墨尔本后，澳大利亚队的阵容只剩下 24 名球员。 意大利人在对阵土耳其队和美国队的比赛中在训练中受伤，而莱基则在球队0-2输给美国队的比赛中腿筋受伤。 澳大利亚此前曾与埃及交手过两次，并于 1987 年在总统杯点球大战中获胜。2010 年，他们在开罗的一场友谊赛中以 3-0 落败。 澳大利亚队在卡塔尔 16 强赛中不敌最终冠军阿根廷队，他们渴望获得历史上首场淘汰赛胜利。 您可以观看 FIFA 世界杯的全部 104 场比赛...

reflection.en: The dramatic conclusion to the World Cup group stage, with teams pushing until the final whistle to secure their place, mirrors the focused effort athletes pour into their pursuit of victory. This striving reminds us of the biblical call to run our own races with purpose and discipline, aiming for the prize with all our might.
reflection.zh: 世界杯小组赛的戏剧性结局，各队拼搏到最后一刻才确定晋级资格，这反映了运动员为追求胜利所付出的专注努力。这种拼搏精神提醒我们，圣经呼召我们带着目标和纪律跑完自己的赛程，竭尽全力争取奖赏。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Socceroos stop the nation as Australia v Paraguay smashes World Cup viewing records
title.zh: 澳大利亚队对巴拉圭的比赛打破世界杯收视纪录，举国关注

summary.en: Australia's national football team, the Socceroos, drew a record-breaking 4.8 million viewers for their World Cup match against Paraguay, making it a significant national event.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚国家足球队“袋鼠军团”与巴拉圭的世界杯比赛吸引了创纪录的480万观众收看，成为一项重要的全国性盛事。

body.en:
On Friday, records were broken when millions of Australians tuned in to see the Socceroos play their highest-stakes FIFA World Cup 2026 match so far.

Attracting nearly five million viewers, it was the most-watched World Cup match in history on SBS, according to national ratings rankings from Virtual Australia (VOZ).

Thrilled fans clamoured in pubs and live sites across the nation at midday on Friday, skipping work and school to witness Australia qualify for the knockout stage of the tournament with a draw against Paraguay,

After a crushing loss to the USA in their second group match of the tournament last week, Australia needed to either beat or tie with Paraguay to secure its spot in the next stage, the Round of 32.

A total of 4.844 million viewers and a total TV average audience of 3.086 million across linear television and digital streaming watched the Australia v Paraguay match.

It is the second most-watched broadcast in SBS history, behind the Socceroos' World Cup play-off victory against Uruguay in 2006 (3.416 million, national average audience).

The Paraguay-Australia post-match program attracted 2.872 million viewers, and the pre-match program attracted 2.277 million viewers.

Between live matches and pre- and post-match shows, SBS had the top three programs of the day and five of the top ten.

Cumulatively, 13.9 million Australians, or about half the population, have watched some of the matches in the FIFA World Cup tournament.

The Socceroos' next game is at 4am Saturday, 4 July (AEST) in Arlington, Texas, near Dallas, when they will face Egypt.

While the cheers and records of such moments are thrilling, Yahweh reminds us to also seek the imperishable crown of eternal values. This perspective helps us appreciate temporary joys while anchoring our deepest...

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Weather tracker: Heatwave expected to bring Germany and Poland to 40C
title.zh: 天气追踪：德国和波兰预计将迎来40摄氏度高温热浪

summary.en: An intense heatwave is expected to bring temperatures up to 40C in parts of central and northern Europe, including Germany and Poland. The Austrian Grand Prix has declared a heat hazard due to the dramatic rise in temperatures.
summary.zh: 预计一股强烈的热浪将使中欧和北欧部分地区（包括德国和波兰）的气温升至40摄氏度。由于气温急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛已宣布高温危险。

body.en: Austrian Grand Prix declares heat hazard as dramatic rise in temperatures forecast in central and northern Europe Temperatures are forecast to rise dramatically in parts of central and northern Europe this weekend as the intense heatwave continues . In Germany and Poland, highs up to or exceeding 40C (104F) are expected on both Saturday and Sunday, days after swathes of France experienced similar extreme temperatures. The Austrian Grand Prix, taking place this weekend in Spielberg, has declared a heat hazard , the first race to do so this season. Temperatures are expected to rise into the low 30s celsius during the race, almost 10C warmer than usual for the venue. Across Europe, the intense heat has led to severe thunderstorms. In the Sverdlovsk region of central Russia, a strong tornado was reported on the evening of 22 June. Rated a 3 out of 5 on the international Fujita scale, the twister injured 16 people and destroyed or damaged about 100 homes and businesses in the town of Kushva. Emergency services have been working on restoring power to the town. Tornadoes are not unheard of in Russia but are rare. Forecasters say they may become more common in future as the climate breaks down. Storm warnings remained in effect in the southern part of the country on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预计中欧和北欧气温将急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛宣布存在热危险 随着强烈热浪的持续，预计本周末中欧和北欧部分地区气温将大幅上升。在德国和波兰，预计周六和周日气温将达到或超过 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），几天前法国大片地区也经历了类似的极端气温。本周末在斯皮尔伯格举行的奥地利大奖赛已宣布出现高温危险，这是本赛季第一场这样做的比赛。预计比赛期间气温将升至 30 摄氏度，比平时高出近 10 摄氏度。在整个欧洲，酷热导致了严重的雷暴天气。 6月22日晚，俄罗斯中部斯维尔德洛夫斯克地区报告出现强烈龙卷风。国际藤田等级评定为 3 级（满分 5 级），龙卷风造成 16 人受伤，并摧毁或损坏了库什瓦镇约 100 所房屋和企业。紧急服务部门一直致力于恢复该镇的供电。龙卷风在俄罗斯并非闻所未闻，但很罕见。预报员表示，随着气候的恶化，它们未来可能会变得更加普遍。周五，该国南部地区的风暴警告仍然有效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic rise in temperatures across Europe reminds us that creation itself is experiencing distress. As the natural world groans under changing conditions, we are called to reflect on our interconnectedness with the earth and its well-being. This intense heatwave serves as a poignant reminder of the broader challenges facing our shared home.
reflection.zh: 欧洲气温的急剧上升提醒我们，受造界本身正在经历痛苦。当自然界在不断变化的环境下发出呻吟时，我们被呼召反思我们与地球及其福祉的相互关联。这场强烈热浪是对我们共同家园所面临的更广泛挑战的深刻提醒。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Xi Jinping has hosted more than a dozen leaders this year, as ‘middle powers’ look beyond the US
title.zh: 习近平今年接待了十几位领导人，‘中间力量’超越美国寻求合作

summary.en: China's leader, Xi Jinping, has hosted numerous world leaders this year, aiming to promote an alternative global order. This effort is reportedly aided by the perceived unpredictability of the United States, prompting 'middle powers' to explore new international alignments.
summary.zh: 中国领导人习近平今年接待了多位世界各国领导人，旨在推动一种替代性的全球秩序。据报道，美国的反复无常助长了这一努力，促使“中等强国”寻求新的国际结盟。

body.en: China’s leader wants to promote his alternative to the current world order, and his efforts are being assisted by a capricious US Xi Jinping meets Bangladesh’s new prime minister on Friday, the latest in a wave of world leaders to visit Beijing this year as the Chinese leader builds his influence and economic ties, and seeks to “shift the balance of power” away from the west. Xi’s meeting with Tarique Rahman comes less than two weeks after the Chinese leader welcomed Myanmar’s military chief-turned-president, Min Aung Hlaing, in Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国领导人希望推行他对当前世界秩序的替代方案，他的努力得到了反复无常的美国的协助。习近平周五会见了孟加拉国新总理，这是今年访问北京的一波世界领导人中最新的一位，中国领导人正在建立影响力和经济联系，并寻求“改变力量平衡”，远离西方。习近平与塔里克·拉赫曼的会面是在中国领导人在北京欢迎缅甸军方最高领导人、现任总统敏昂莱之后不到两周。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights how nations are drawn to leaders who articulate a clear vision for the future, especially when existing global structures seem uncertain. Proverbs 29:18 reminds us that without a guiding vision, people and nations can lose their way. This underscores the profound impact of leadership that offers a coherent path forward.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调，当现有的全球秩序显得不确定时，各国会被那些为未来描绘清晰愿景的领导人所吸引。箴言29:18提醒我们，没有指引的异象，人民和国家就会迷失方向。这突显了提供连贯前进道路的领导力所产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: UK to halve tariff-free steel imports to counter glut of cheap Chinese metal
title.zh: 英国将削减免关税钢材进口量以应对廉价中国金属过剩

summary.en: The UK government announced it will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports, doubling duties on quantities exceeding the new quota. This measure, mirrored by similar changes in EU limits, aims to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and support domestic industry.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布将把免关税钢材进口量减半，超出新配额的进口将加倍征收关税。此举与欧盟的类似调整相呼应，旨在应对全球廉价中国金属的过剩供应，并扶持本国产业。

body.en: Duty on imports outside new quota will double in move echoing similar changes in EU limits Business live – latest updates The UK government will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports allowed in an attempt to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and bolster its beleaguered local industry. New “safeguards” will be introduced on 1 July and will coincide with similar new limits being introduced by the EU for the same purposes. The UK said it and the EU had agreed an approach that reflected each other’s “highly interconnected supply chains” after months of negotiations over retaining tariff-free access between the markets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新配额之外的进口关税将翻倍，与欧盟限制的类似变化相呼应英国政府将允许的免关税钢铁进口量减半，以应对全球廉价中国金属供应过剩的问题，并提振陷入困境的当地工业。新的“保障措施”将于 7 月 1 日推出，并将与欧盟出于相同目的推出的类似新限制同时实施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often grapple with balancing economic interests and ensuring fair trade practices. Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that Yahweh values honest dealings and just measures in commerce. This principle encourages leaders to seek equitable solutions that promote integrity in global markets.
reflection.zh: 国家常在经济利益与确保公平贸易实践之间寻求平衡。箴言11:1提醒我们，雅伟看重商业中的诚实交易和公正的度量。这一原则鼓励领导者寻求公平的解决方案，以促进全球市场的诚信。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What is China’s SpaceSail, and could it rival Elon Musk’s Starlink?
title.zh: 中国的“太空帆”是什么？它能与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争吗？

summary.en: China's state-backed SpaceSail project is developing a satellite internet constellation to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. With hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit, the company is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries.
summary.zh: 中国国家支持的“太空帆”项目正在开发一个卫星互联网星座，旨在与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争。该公司目前在近地轨道拥有数百颗卫星，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判。

body.en: The company has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit but has state backing and is already reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries Elon Musk’s Starlink has long dominated the satellite internet industry, but a Chinese government-backed project is aiming to challenge its position. SpaceSail has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit compared with Starlink’s 10,000-plus. But the company says it now has enough satellites to begin its first commercial application, is scaling up at speed, and is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries to provide satellite internet coverage. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星，但有国家支持，据报道已经与数十个国家进行谈判。埃隆·马斯克的星链长期以来一直主导着卫星互联网行业，但一个中国政府支持的项目旨在挑战其地位。与 Starlink 的 10,000 多颗卫星相比，SpaceSail 在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星。但该公司表示，它现在拥有足够的卫星来开始其首次商业应用，并且正在快速扩大规模，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判以提供卫星互联网覆盖。继续阅读...

Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our efforts, when aligned with His purposes, will find success. This perspective can guide us in all our endeavors, from grand...
reflection.zh: 当各国和公司着手像“太空帆”这样雄心勃勃的技术项目时，这提醒我们人类创新和连接世界的动力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将我们的计划交托给雅伟，相信我们的努力，若与祂的旨意相符，必将成功。这种视角可以指导我们所有的努力，无论是宏伟的项目还是日常任务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Dear You review – enjoyable Chinese romdram crosses generations as it tracks down a missing husband
title.zh: 《亲爱的你》影评：一部跨越世代、追寻失踪丈夫的感人华语爱情剧情片

summary.en: The Guardian China reviews "Dear You," a Chinese romantic drama by director Lan Hongchun. The film is a multi-generational family saga, spanning from the 1940s to the present, primarily set in Bangkok, and follows the search for a husband who disappeared in Thailand.
summary.zh: 《卫报中国》评论了导演蓝鸿春的华语爱情剧情片《亲爱的你》。这部电影是一部跨越几代人的家族传奇，故事从20世纪40年代至今，主要背景设在曼谷，讲述了一个家庭寻找在泰国失踪的丈夫的故事。

body.en: Director Lan Hongchun’s family saga feels like a good old-fashioned novel as it goes in search of a man who has disappeared in Thailand With a story that ranges from the 1940s to the present and, although mostly set in Bangkok, revolving largely around Teochew-speaking Chinese from Guangdong, this generations-spanning drama feels like a good old-fashioned novel. A romantic beach read, perhaps, the kind in which coincidences and random accidents cause misunderstandings that last for decades until the truth is finally revealed. It’s sentimental in places, sure, but there’s also a fair bit of salty, bawdy humour to cut the sweetness, lashings of period colour, and impressively naturalistic performances from a mostly non-professional cast. All that has helped to make this an unexpectedly large box-office hit in the People’s Republic last month; and for non-Chinese or Thai rom-dram aficionados anywhere, it’s well worth looking out for. As the story opens in the 21st century in the Chinese city of Shantou, octogenarian Shurou (Iap Sok-jiu) is celebrating her 87th birthday, surrounded by adoring friends, family and neighbours who revere the matriarch, not least for managing to raise three kids on her own in the 1940s and 50s. Her shifty grandson Xiaowei (Hiau-ui), however, is less of a solid citizen and, having got into debt, he decides to travel to Bangkok to find out if Shurou’s husband Zheng Musheng, not seen for decades, could help out since he’s reputed to have made a fortune out there, endowed schools all over Thailand, and had a second family after abandoning Shurou. Continue reading...
body.zh: 导演兰鸿春的家庭传奇感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说，讲述了在泰国寻找失踪男子的故事。故事范围从 20 世纪 40 年代至今，虽然主要以曼谷为背景，但主要围绕来自广东的潮州华人展开，这部跨越几代人的戏剧感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说。浪漫的海滩读物，也许是那种巧合和偶然的事故会导致持续数十年的误会，直到真相最终揭晓的类型。当然，它在某些地方是感伤的，但也有一些咸味、下流的幽默来削弱甜蜜，充满时代色彩，以及来自大多数非专业演员的令人印象深刻的自然主义表演。所有这些都使得该片上个月在中华人民共和国取得了意想不到的票房大成功。对于任何地方的非中国或泰国的浪漫剧爱好者来说，这都非常值得一看。故事发生在 21 世纪的中国汕头市，八十多岁的淑柔（叶淑如饰）正在庆祝她的 87 岁生日，周围都是崇拜这位女族长的朋友、家人和邻居，尤其是她在 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代设法独自抚养三个孩子。然而，她狡猾的孙子小伟（孝仪饰）却不是一个踏实的公民，负债累累，他决定前往曼谷，看看书柔数十年未见的丈夫郑木胜是否可以帮忙，因为他在外面发了大财，为泰国各地的学校捐款，并在抛弃书柔后有了第二个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The multi-generational search for a missing husband in "Dear You" powerfully illustrates the enduring nature of family bonds. This long quest reflects the deep commitment inherent in marriage, where two become one, a union that transcends time and distance. It reminds us that true connection often calls for steadfastness, even in the face of profound...
reflection.zh: 电影《亲爱的你》中跨越几代人寻找失踪丈夫的故事，有力地展现了家庭纽带的持久性。这场漫长的寻觅反映了婚姻中固有的深刻承诺，夫妻二人成为一体，这种结合超越了时间和距离。它提醒我们，真正的连接往往需要坚韧不拔，即使面对巨大的不确定性也是如此。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Dettol apologises after ‘toxic men’ advert sparks backlash in China
title.zh: 滴露因“有毒男性”广告在中国引发反弹后致歉

summary.en: British hygiene brand Dettol has apologized and withdrawn an advertisement in China that sparked widespread condemnation. The advert, which the company stated was intended to criticize “toxic men,” featured a man seeking a “clean and untouched” woman.
summary.zh: 英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告引发广泛谴责后，已致歉并撤回该广告。滴露公司称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，但其内容却描绘了一名男子寻找“干净纯洁”女性的情节。

body.en: British disinfectant brand withdraws advert about a man’s efforts to find a ‘clean and untouched’ woman The British hygiene brand Dettol has apologised after an advertisement released in China, which it said was intended to criticise “toxic men”, was widely condemned on social media as offensive to women. The five-minute advert for a multipurpose disinfectant, released across many online platforms at the end of May, features a man comparing his girlfriend with his former partner. Learning that his former girlfriend previously lived with someone else, the man likens their relationship to a “secondhand service”. He then tells his friends that he intends to find a “clean and untouched” woman for whom he can be the first sexual partner. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国消毒剂品牌撤回有关男性努力寻找“干净、未受影响”女性的广告英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告道歉，称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，该广告在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责，认为该广告冒犯了女性。五月底，多用途消毒剂的五分钟广告在多个在线平台上发布，其中一名男子将他的女朋友与他的前伴侣进行了比较。当得知他的前女友以前与别人住在一起时，该男子将他们的关系比作“二手服务”。然后他告诉他的朋友，他打算找一个“干净、未受污染”的女人作为他的第一个性伴侣。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The controversy surrounding Dettol's advertisement highlights the importance of recognizing the inherent dignity of every individual. When an advert reduces women to an object defined by their perceived “purity” or “untouched” status, it diminishes the profound truth that all people, male and female, are created in the image of Yahweh. This reminds us to...
reflection.zh: 滴露广告引发的争议，凸显了承认每个人固有尊严的重要性。当一个广告将女性贬低为由其所谓的“纯洁”或“未被触碰”状态来定义的客体时，它就削弱了一个深刻的真理：所有的人，无论男女，都是按雅伟的形象被造的。这提醒我们要维护他人的价值，反映出神赋予每个生命的尊贵。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Chinese supercomputer leapfrogs best US machines to be ranked world’s fastest

body.en: China’s LineShine debuts at number one in Top500 – a list sometimes viewed as a national measure of global tech prowess A supercomputer in China now outranks its US counterparts as the world’s most powerful. It is the first time since 2017 that a Chinese computer has topped a list sometimes viewed as a measure of a nation’s technological prowess. The LineShine computer in Shenzhen displaced top-ranked US computer El Capitan in the Top500 rankings released on Tuesday. It was LineShine’s debut on the list. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国的 LineShine 首次跻身 Top500 排行榜第一名——该榜单有时被视为衡量全球科技实力的国家标准。中国的超级计算机现已超过美国同行，成为世界上最强大的计算机。这是自 2017 年以来中国计算机首次跻身有时被视为衡量一个国家技术实力的榜单榜首。在周二发布的 Top500 排名中，深圳的 LineShine 计算机取代了排名第一的美国计算机 El Capitan。这是 LineShine 首次上榜。继续阅读...

title.en: Francis Markus obituary
title.zh: 弗朗西斯·马库斯讣告

summary.en: Francis Markus, former BBC Shanghai correspondent, has died at 65 from cancer. Driven by compassion for those he reported on, he dedicated the last two decades of his life to working for humanitarian organizations across Asia.

After being posted to Shanghai in 2002, Francis demonstrated not just an unerring news sense, covering protests in Hong Kong and social change in China, but a deep interest in human stories, from the suicide-watchers patrolling one of China’s highest bridges over the Yangtze River, to the lives of those dealing with HIV. His dedication to humanitarian work in Asia reminds us that Yahweh sees and values every act of kindness shown to those in need. Such a life, marked by selfless care, reflects a deep understanding of what it means to truly love our...
reflection.zh: 弗朗西斯·马库斯的一生展现了深刻的同情心，他超越了观察，积极地为弱势群体服务。他在亚洲投身人道主义工作的奉献提醒我们，雅伟看重并珍视对有需要之人所施行的每一份善举。这样以无私关怀为标志的生命，反映了对真正爱邻舍的深刻理解。

verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai honored by DW
title.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获德国之声表彰

summary.en: Jimmy Lai, a Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher, has been honored by DW. He founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper before being sentenced to 20 years in prison. His son stated that the award signifies that those who advocate for the freedom of others are not alone.
summary.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获得德国之声表彰。他在被判处20年监禁前，创办了香港最大的亲民主报纸。他的儿子表示，这个奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“从不孤单”。

body.en:
Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."

Arriving in Hong Kong as a penniless 12-year-old stowaway from southern China, Jimmy Lai sought only freedom and a future. At the time, Lai could never have imagined how his life would become forever intertwined with this former British colony.

"I'll sink with the ship, because this place gives me everything," said Lai in an interview about Hong Kong with DW a few months before he was taken into custody in December 2020. He was one of the first high-profile figures to be targeted under a "national security law" imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing following a crackdown on pro-democracy protests.

Beijing had said the law would restore Hong Kong "from chaos to order" after demonstrations in 2019 opposing an extradition bill morphed into massive protests against Beijing encroaching on Hong Kong's civil liberties .

Since then, the pro-democracy media mogul has spent more than 2,000 days in solitary confinement in Hong Kong's maximum-security Stanley Prison.

Lai's years-long trial ended this February, when the 78-year-old was sentenced to 20 years in prison for "colluding with foreign forces." While he had pleaded not guilty to all charges, his legal team said he will not appeal.

The sentence is the heaviest punishment handed down so far under the national security law, and Lai's trial has symbolized for many people the severe erosion of press freedom in Hong Kong as part of Beijing's broader strategy to silence critical voices.

In recognition of his defense of press freedom and freedom of speech, DW honored Jimmy Lai with this year's Freedom of Speech Award  at the annual Global Media Forum in Bonn, Germany, on Tuesday.

"While we have spoken freely in the defence of independent media, Jimmy, who founded an independent media company because he believed in the rights of the Hong Kong people to receive information, is locked away for those beliefs," Jodie Ginsberg, CEO of the Committee to Protect Journalists, said in a speech honoring Lai.

"The attacks on Apple Daily and its counterparts in Hong Kong presaged the far greater attacks on civil liberties in the years that followed. Jimmy Lai saw this and spoke out. We can honor him today not only by fighting for his freedom, but by defending the freedoms for which he was jailed."

Since 2015, the DW Freedom of Speech Award has honored journalists and human rights defenders as a way to call attention to restrictions on press freedom and concerning human rights situations around the world.

body.zh: 在入狱20年之前，黎智英创办了香港最大的民主报纸。他的儿子表示，该奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“永远不会孤单”。 黎智英 (Jimmy Lai) 12 岁，身无分文，从中国南方偷渡到香港，他只寻求自由和未来。当时，黎智英无法想象他的生活将如何与这个前英国殖民地永远交织在一起。 黎智英在 2020 年 12 月被拘留前几个月接受德国之声采访时表示，“我将与船一起沉没，因为这个地方给了我一切。”黎智英是北京在镇压亲民主抗议活动后对香港实施的“国家安全法”中首批成为目标的知名人士之一。 在2019年反对引渡法案的示威演变成针对北京侵犯香港公民自由的大规模抗议活动后，北京曾表示，该法律将使香港“从混乱中恢复秩序”。 此后，这位亲民主媒体大亨在香港戒备森严的赤柱监狱中被单独监禁了 2000 多天。 黎智英长达数年的审判于今年 2 月结束，78 岁的他因“勾结外国势力”被判处 20 年徒刑。虽然他对所有指控均表示不认罪，但他的法律团队表示他不会上诉。 这一判决是迄今为止根据国家安全法作出的最重处罚，对许多人来说，黎智英的审判象征着香港新闻自由的严重侵蚀，而这是北京压制批评声音的更广泛战略的一部分。 为了表彰黎智英对新闻自由和言论自由的捍卫，周二在德国波恩举行的年度全球媒体论坛上，德国之声授予黎智英今年的言论自由奖。 保护记者委员会首席执行官朱迪·金斯伯格(Jodie Ginsberg)在向黎智英致敬的演讲中表示：“虽然我们畅所欲言地捍卫独立媒体，但吉米因为相信香港人民有权接收信息而创立了一家独立媒体公司，但他却因为这些信念而被关起来。” “对《苹果日报》及其香港同行的攻击预示着随后几年对公民自由的更大攻击。黎智英看到了这一点并大声疾呼。今天我们不仅可以通过为他的自由而奋斗，而且可以通过捍卫他被监禁的自由来向他致敬。” 自 2015 年以来，德国之声言论自由奖一直向记者和人权捍卫者授予荣誉，以此呼吁人们关注世界各地对新闻自由的限制和人权状况。 黎智英的儿子塞巴斯蒂安·赖（Sebastien Lai）是黎智英释放的长期倡导者，他在四月份告诉德国之声，“那些反抗的人......

reflection.en: Jimmy Lai's recognition, even amidst his imprisonment, highlights the enduring cost of standing for truth and freedom. Yahweh's word reminds us that those who face persecution for righteousness are truly blessed, finding a profound solidarity that transcends their circumstances. This spiritual truth offers hope that their sacrifices are seen and honored,...
reflection.zh: 黎智英在狱中获得表彰，凸显了为真理和自由挺身而出的持久代价。雅伟的话语提醒我们，那些因行义而受逼迫的人是有福的，他们会找到一种超越境况的深刻团结。这个属灵真理带来希望，他们的牺牲是被看见和尊重的，即便人间的公义有时会失落。

verse.textEn: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verse.textZh: 为义受逼迫的人有福了，因为天国是他们的。

title.en: Charging ahead: EVs outpace growth predictions
title.zh: 充电加速：电动汽车增长超预期

summary.en: China is driving the electric vehicle transition but Europe and other countries are catching up fast. EVs are getting cheaper, more efficient and can travel farther than ever.

title.en: NSW to give $34 million boost to shark-spotting drones with hope of eventual AI automation
title.zh: 新南威尔士州将拨款 3400 万澳元用于鲨鱼识别无人机，希望最终实现人工智能自动化

summary.en: Under the expanded monitoring program, 72 beaches will now have a fleet of drones watching over them 365 days a year.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A fleet of drones will patrol NSW beaches from dawn to dusk to spot sharks as artificial intelligence is touted as a long-term solution to saving lives.

NSW Premier Chris Minns said his government would invest an extra $34 million in a major scale-up of drone coverage across beaches in Sydney and along the state's coast.

The plan follows a great white shark attack on a woman swimming between the flags at Sydney's popular Coogee Beach on 13 June.

Teacher Leah Stewart, 34, was critically injured and later had her arm amputated following the mauling.

Under the expanded monitoring program, announced on Sunday, 72 beaches — including at least one in every coastal local government area — will benefit from a fleet of drones watching over them 365 days a year.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"No one can promise a shark mitigation program that can guarantee that there will be zero encounters with sharks," Minns told reporters at Cronulla.

"But our plan here is to reduce the risk for swimmers and surfers in NSW beaches by using the latest technology ... so that you get earlier warning if you're in the water that there is a shark in the vicinity."

The program could eventually culminate in the use of autonomous, AI-enabled drones, rather than human-controlled craft.

"When we can roll out automated drones and AI-assisted monitoring, (it) will make a big difference ... because we'll be able to identify and distinguish between different kinds of marine life for the first time."

Beaches with high numbers of water users will be prioritised for the additional monitoring.

The bolstered surveillance will kick off on Wednesday and include year-round coverage of all of Sydney's main beaches.

Some 500,000 drone flights were expected to be logged annually, Surf Life Saving NSW head Steve Pearce said while pointing to a drone being tested overhead.

"This is just one of a fleet of drones ... that will be rolled out, up and down the NSW coastline, that allows our pilots to pilot drones hundreds of kilometres away from where they're actually situated," he said.

Controversial shark nets will be retained at some beaches, but they will be fortified by aerial surveillance.

Humane World for Animals Australia marine biologist Lawrence Chlebeck welcomed the world-leading commitment to drones, which he said were the best way to watch for sharks and reduce the risk of bites.

But he urged the government to scrap shark nets because they entangle other animals and are considered outdated and ineffective by the scientific community.

The nets, which are removed during the winter whale migration season, will be reinstalled in September.

summary.en: It's been debated for decades, but some experts say conditions may finally be right for high-speed rail in Australia.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Jon Staniland is one of many commuters on the 4.33pm train to Newcastle who has settled in for a long journey home.

Door to door, it can take Staniland up to two hours to travel home from work in Sydney's CBD to Woy Woy on the Central Coast, although the trip can be as short as one hour and 40 minutes if he gets an express train.

When SBS News meets him on a Monday afternoon, Staniland is working on his laptop. His employer allows him to leave the office early — around 3pm — and finish the rest of his work while in transit.

The 51-year-old makes this four-hour return journey twice a week, but Staniland says he wouldn't have it any other way. He has lived in Woy Woy for 10 years and loves the lifestyle.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Staniland is one of the growing number of Australians choosing to live in regional areas for lifestyle and cost of living reasons, while maintaining jobs in the capital cities.

He's also among the commuters who stand to benefit from a proposed high-speed rail line between Newcastle and Sydney, a project described as a once-in-a-century opportunity to reshape Australia and redefine how people live, work and travel.

The project has progressed to a two-year development phase following the release of a partially redacted business case by the High Speed Rail Authority in February.

The new rail line would slash travel times from Sydney to the Central Coast to around 30 minutes, while the journey to Newcastle would take less than an hour — compared with about two and a half hours by train today.

It would also allow passengers to travel from Newcastle to the new airport in Western Sydney in about 90 minutes.

The federal government announced the start of a two-year development phase in March. Last week, expressions of interest closed for the design and construction of the rail line between the Central Coast township of Ourimbah and Central Station in Sydney's CBD.

In an opinion piece published on 4 March, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said: "The time has come for high-speed rail in Australia — for the good of Australians and, as the business case now shows, for the good of the economy."

While the project still faces significant engineering, funding and political challenges, some experts believe this is the closest Australia has come to getting a high-speed rail project off the ground, and the timing may finally be right.

The idea of high-speed rail excites many Australians, but previous plans have often been stymied by the high costs required.

body.en:
A new generation of influencers is promoting extreme thinness to millions online. Dateline investigates the growing trend and meets the families taking on Big Tech. Watch Under the Thinfluence on Tuesday 30 June at 9.30pm (AEST) on SBS or SBS On Demand.

Content warning: This article contains references to body image and eating disorders.

For Luka and her family, Christmases and special events like birthdays are fraught.

Every year, Luka wants her mum to make her a birthday cake, even though she knows she'll never eat it.

The 23-year-old from Hervey Bay in southern Queensland has lived with anorexia nervosa — one of Australia's deadliest mental illnesses — for nearly a decade. She's been in treatment for six years and is now in recovery.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I had nurses checking on me in the night because I was at risk of my bones protruding through my skin," Luka tells Dateline.

It's a far cry from the little girl she once was — fascinated with healthy eating and nutritious recipes she found on social media. 

"I remember seeing people's exercise routines, their diets and what they ate. And I don't think I was, as a nine-year-old, actively looking for that stuff; I think that's what came up."

When Luka was scouted to become a model at age 13, her interest in her appearance grew; she wanted to look like the models she saw on social media.

Her mother Suze watched in dismay at the constant information Luka was exposed to.

"Whether it's fasting, whether it's eating eight small meals a day, whether it's eating this many grams of protein ... you just get bombarded," she says.

Over time, Luka's interest in healthy eating became an obsession, and she became ill.

"Every birthday, every Easter, we've got all these other alternative Easter presents for Luka that aren't related to food because I didn't want her to miss out," Suze says.

"It's like eating disorder Olympics. You strive for that one goal. To be the thinnest, to be the most in control, to be the sickest, to be suffering the most, to be the most underweight.

For some online content creators, thinness means rising in the ranks on social media.

Popular videos that include commentary on 'What I eat in a day' have become so common that they've been shortened to 'WIEIAD' — typically featuring clean and whole foods, aesthetically plated and presented.

A growing number of social media accounts have built their brand around thinness, weaving it into fitness content, fashion and 'wellness' posts. Known as 'thinfluencers', these influencers centre their content on the pursuit of being thin.

title.en: Fourth positive bird flu case confirmed amid surge of calls to animal disease hotline

summary.en: Officials have confirmed a fourth case of bird flu, leading to over four hundred reports to the emergency animal hotline in just over a week.

body.en:
Western Australia has confirmed its third positive bird flu case, the fourth recorded in Australia in one week.

The deadly H5 strain of avian influenza was found in a giant petrel discovered in Quindalup, on the state's south-west coast, and confirmed by the CSIRO's Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness on Saturday morning.

There have been four positive cases of H5 bird flu in Australia since 20 June, when the federal government confirmed that two migratory seabirds suspected to be infected with the virus returned positive results.

These first two cases, a brown skua and a giant petrel, were found in the remote Cape Le Grand area, east of Esperance.

The government said on Saturday that the results of a fifth possible positive case, in another giant petrel found west of Esperance, were pending.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In the week since reports first emerged of a suspected H5 influenza case on 19 June, Western Australians have made more than 400 reports to the Emergency Animal Disease hotline.

Of these reports, 53 have been prioritised for further investigation by the Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development.

Across the state, 17 negative results have been recorded in the Esperance area, Mid West, Great Southern, South West, Peel and the Perth metropolitan area.

Australia was the last continent to record cases of the highly contagious and deadly strain of bird flu.

So far, three of four confirmed cases were in migratory seabirds found in Western Australia.

South Australia also detected a case in a giant petrel found in the Fleurieu Peninsula on 14 June.

Australia's chief veterinary officer, Dr Beth Cookson, said on Saturday that there was so far no indication the disease had spread to domesticated animals.

"At this stage, there have only been detections in vagrant migratory seabirds that occasionally visit southern Australia," Cookson said.

"There remains no evidence of any mass mortality events and there are no detections in poultry or in our agricultural production system.

Cookson said genomic sequencing indicated that the virus infecting the first confirmed wild bird case in Australia was related to an outbreak on the Heard and McDonald Islands, about 4,100km south-west of Perth.

A recent study found the disease killed 13,000 elephant seal pups on the sub-Antarctic islands, which are Australian external territories.

The arrival of H5 bird flu in Australia prompted grave concerns from scientists over its potential to devastate native wildlife and domesticated bird species.

In both poultry and wild birds, H5 viruses can spread rapidly and cause severe disease, neurological defects, and sudden death....
body.zh: 西澳大利亚州确认了第三例禽流感阳性病例，这是澳大利亚一周内记录的第四例。 在该州西南海岸昆达卢普发现的一只巨型海燕身上发现了致命的 H5 禽流感病毒，并于周六上午得到了 CSIRO 澳大利亚疾病预防中心的证实。 自6月20日联邦政府确认两只疑似感染该病毒的候鸟海鸟返回阳性结果以来，澳大利亚已出现四例H5禽流感阳性病例。 前两个病例是一只棕色贼鸥和一只巨型海燕，是在埃斯佩兰斯以东偏远的勒格兰德角地区发现的。 政府周六表示，第五例可能呈阳性的病例（在埃斯佩兰斯以西发现的另一只巨型海燕）的结果仍在等待中。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 自 6 月 19 日首次报告疑似 H5 流感病例以来的一周内，西澳大利亚人已向动物疾病紧急热线报告了 400 多份报告。 在这些报告中，第一产业和区域发展部已优先对 53 份报告进行进一步调查。 全州范围内，埃斯佩兰斯地区、中西部、大南部、西南、皮尔和珀斯大都市区已录得 17 例阴性结果。 澳大利亚是最后一个记录高度传染性和致命性禽流感病例的大陆。 到目前为止，四分之三的确诊病例是在西澳大利亚发现的候鸟海鸟中。 6 月 14 日，南澳大利亚州在弗勒里厄半岛发现的一只巨型海燕中也发现了病例。 澳大利亚首席兽医官贝丝·库克森博士周六表示，到目前为止，没有迹象表明这种疾病已传播给家养动物。 库克森说：“现阶段，仅检测到偶尔访问澳大利亚南部的流浪迁徙海鸟。” “目前还没有任何大规模死亡事件的证据，在家禽或我们的农业生产系统中也没有检测到任何病毒。 库克森说，基因组测序表明，感染澳大利亚首例确诊野鸟病例的病毒与珀斯西南约4100公里处的赫德岛和麦克唐纳岛的疫情有关。 最近的一项研究发现，这种疾病导致亚南极岛屿（澳大利亚的外部领土）上的 13,000 只象海豹幼崽死亡。 H5 禽流感在澳大利亚的到来引起了科学家的严重担忧，担心它有可能破坏本土野生动物和驯养鸟类。 在家禽和野鸟中，H5 病毒可以迅速传播并导致严重疾病、神经缺陷和猝死……

reflection.en: The rapid spread of bird flu among animals reminds us that creation itself groans under the weight of brokenness, awaiting full redemption. Our vigilance in reporting and responding to such outbreaks reflects a compassionate concern for the well-being of all life. Yahweh hears the cries of creation and calls us to be attentive stewards.

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Socceroos stop the nation as Australia v Paraguay smashes World Cup viewing records
title.zh: 澳大利亚队对巴拉圭的比赛打破世界杯收视纪录，举国关注

summary.en: Australia's national football team, the Socceroos, drew a record-breaking 4.8 million viewers for their World Cup match against Paraguay, making it a significant national event.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚国家足球队“袋鼠军团”与巴拉圭的世界杯比赛吸引了创纪录的480万观众收看，成为一项重要的全国性盛事。

body.en:
On Friday, records were broken when millions of Australians tuned in to see the Socceroos play their highest-stakes FIFA World Cup 2026 match so far.

Attracting nearly five million viewers, it was the most-watched World Cup match in history on SBS, according to national ratings rankings from Virtual Australia (VOZ).

Thrilled fans clamoured in pubs and live sites across the nation at midday on Friday, skipping work and school to witness Australia qualify for the knockout stage of the tournament with a draw against Paraguay,

After a crushing loss to the USA in their second group match of the tournament last week, Australia needed to either beat or tie with Paraguay to secure its spot in the next stage, the Round of 32.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A total of 4.844 million viewers and a total TV average audience of 3.086 million across linear television and digital streaming watched the Australia v Paraguay match.

It is the second most-watched broadcast in SBS history, behind the Socceroos' World Cup play-off victory against Uruguay in 2006 (3.416 million, national average audience).

The Paraguay-Australia post-match program attracted 2.872 million viewers, and the pre-match program attracted 2.277 million viewers.

Between live matches and pre- and post-match shows, SBS had the top three programs of the day and five of the top ten.

Cumulatively, 13.9 million Australians, or about half the population, have watched some of the matches in the FIFA World Cup tournament.

The Socceroos' next game is at 4am Saturday, 4 July (AEST) in Arlington, Texas, near Dallas, when they will face Egypt.

body.zh: 周五，数以百万计的澳大利亚人收看澳大利亚队进行迄今为止风险最高的 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯比赛，这一纪录被打破。 根据 Virtual Australia (VOZ) 的全国收视率排名，这场比赛吸引了近 500 万观众，是 SBS 历史上收视率最高的世界杯比赛。 周五中午，兴奋的球迷们在全国各地的酒吧和现场欢呼雀跃，翘班翘课，见证澳大利亚队与巴拉圭队战平，晋级世界杯淘汰赛阶段， 继上周小组赛第二场惨败给美国队之后，澳大利亚需要击败或打平巴拉圭才能确保进入下一阶段32强赛。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 共有 484.4 万观众观看了澳大利亚对阵巴拉圭的比赛，线性电视和数字流媒体的电视平均观众总数为 308.6 万。 这是SBS历史上收视率第二高的节目，仅次于2006年澳大利亚队在世界杯附加赛中战胜乌拉圭的比赛（全国平均收视率341.6万人）。 巴拉圭对澳大利亚赛后节目吸引了287.2万人次观看，赛前节目吸引了227.7万人次观看。 在现场比赛和赛前赛后节目中，SBS 拥有当天排名前三的节目以及前十名中的五个节目。 累计有 1,390 万澳大利亚人（约占总人口的一半）观看了 FIFA 世界杯的部分比赛。 澳大利亚队的下一场比赛将于 7 月 4 日（澳大利亚东部时间）星期六凌晨 4 点在达拉斯附近的德克萨斯州阿灵顿举行，届时他们将对阵埃及。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: A national sporting event can unite millions in shared excitement, offering a glimpse of collective passion and the pursuit of a common goal. While the cheers and records of such moments are thrilling, Yahweh reminds us to also seek the imperishable crown of eternal values. This perspective helps us appreciate temporary joys while anchoring our deepest...
reflection.zh: 一场全国性的体育赛事能让数百万人团结在共同的兴奋之中，展现出集体的热情和对共同目标的追求。虽然这些时刻的欢呼和纪录令人激动，但雅伟提醒我们也要寻求那永不朽坏的、永恒价值的冠冕。这种视角帮助我们欣赏暂时的喜乐，同时将我们最深的盼望根植于真正持久的事物。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。
